text:
joni (Sales): FYI: Quartz Labs wants a two-week POC for a custom model they call 'orca-slim-12b-q6'. Scope: Dedicated A100, session-persistent KV cache, reserved pricing for ~1M tokens/mo, and Private VPC with BYO-KMS. Looping in @kevin_ml @maya_ops @arun_sec.

kevin_ml (Eng-ML): Quick clarifier — did they export the model with any operator fusion or custom CUDA kernels? That affects compatibility. Also what's their target p95?

joni (Sales): They said p95 target is 300ms for short queries. Typical prompts ~35 tokens, responses ~160 tokens. They mentioned doing some export-time fusion.

kevin_ml (Eng-ML): Fusion = potential runtime kernel mismatch. Ask them for either the unfused checkpoint or the fused-op sources & build info (CUDA/cuDNN versions). If neither available, we can run a compatibility test but may need a custom runtime build. Prep time ~3 business days worst-case.

maya_ops (Solutions): Ballpark reserved economics for a 12B q6-ish variant on A100: ~$0.005–0.011 per 1k tokens effective, heavily dependent on batch hit & KV hit rates. I'll calc precise numbers after perf tests.

arun_sec (Security): BYO-KMS + Private VPC supported. We'll need their KMS ARN, key policy, rotation cadence, and completed security questionnaire. If they plan to ingest regulated data mark that in the questionnaire (PHI triggers compliance review).

kevin_ml (Eng-ML): For staging tests I need: model artifact (wheel/checkpoint), a 30–50 prompt validation set, and expected concurrency profile (burst pattern). Example smoke config I'd run: ```
model: orca-slim-12b-q6
precision: q6
hardware: a100-40gb
batching:
  max_tokens_per_batch: 4096
  latency_target_ms: 275
kv_cache: prefix_session_persistent
seq_max: 2048
```

joni (Sales): I'll ask them for the artifacts and the 50 prompts now.

ops-bot: Ticket #POC-5599 created: "quartz-poc-staging" assigned to eng-ml and eng-infra. ETA: 48h. :package:

maya_ops (Solutions): Note — if their fused export uses custom fused attention we may need their training repo commit and the exact export command. That helps reproduce the export in our infra. Also KV hit rate assumptions change cost significantly; ask if they expect high prefix reuse.

joni (Sales): Quartz says ~60% prefix reuse in sessions. They will provide repo commit if needed.

arun_sec (Security): Also request their retention requirements and whether they want logs forwarded to their SIEM. For BYO-KMS we require an IAM policy template to attach; we can share ours.

kevin_ml (Eng-ML): If they can share a tiny perf sample (5 concurrent workers sending short prompts) that helps establish realistic latency under burst. I'll run perf + a quick quality comparison vs our baseline and report back.

maya_ops (Solutions): After kevin's perf numbers I'll draft a reserved pool recommendation and an effective per-token estimate. Expect draft within 48h post-perf.

joni (Sales): Great — I'll push them to upload artifacts and mark the security questionnaire high priority. Will post updates here. :rocket:
